before_metrics.comment: exp-20260531-006 (composite quintile) and exp-20260601-003 (component decomposition) ran on the narrow 52-name curated momentum-homogeneous watchlist: composite 5d +0.56pp (barely cleared floor), relative_strength +0.81pp, verdict momentum_only. This re-runs both on a broad 1446-ticker heterogeneous universe.

change_summary: Robustness re-run on the broad 1446-ticker all-windows-full-liquid universe (exp-20260519-030 warehouse), 96833 pooled (day,ticker) observations across the canonical 3 windows. Loads each qualified ticker's full OHLCV once, scores the full universe PIT every 5th trading day via compute_features + build_cross_sectional_ranking_surface, then reuses the exp-20260531-006 quantile and exp-20260601-003 component+RS-double-sort judges. Result: broadening the universe SHRINKS the edge. Composite 5d quintile spread collapses from +0.56pp (narrow) to +0.21pp (below 0.5pp floor); relative_strength shrinks from +0.81pp to +0.34pp (also below floor); NO component clears the bar. The composite per-window spread is positive in only 1/3 windows (late_strong +0.59pp; mid_weak -0.24pp; old_thin -0.09pp) -- the entire tilt is one strong-market regime. expectation/PEAD remain perfectly constant (unpopulated for non-curated tickers).
decision_rule: Reuse exp-20260531-006 composite quintile judge (accept needs monotonic ladder + majority-positive windows + >=0.5pp 5d spread) and exp-20260601-003 component judge (non-momentum component needs cross-sectional dispersion + majority windows + spread surviving RS double-sort). Both returned non-accept on the broad universe.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Does the narrow-universe 'alpha_score = relative_strength only' conclusion generalize to a broad heterogeneous universe?
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260531-006 (narrow composite quintile), exp-20260601-003 (narrow component decomposition), exp-20260530-022 (filled-trade degenerate).
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Universe breadth (52 curated -> 1446 all-windows-full-liquid warehouse), same scoring + judging machinery.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Composite quintile ladder cleaner/monotonic OR a non-momentum component shows an RS-independent edge on the broad universe.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: load warehouse all_windows_full_liquid tickers, sample every 5th day, score full universe PIT, reuse exp-006/003 judges. 5 new helper tests + reused tested machinery.

hypothesis: The exp-20260601-003 conclusion (composite alpha_score edge is only relative_strength) was derived on a narrow 52-name momentum-homogeneous curated watchlist and may not generalize. Re-running on the broad 1446-ticker all-windows-full-liquid warehouse universe tests whether the composite ladder becomes cleaner/monotonic and whether any non-momentum component shows an incremental RS-independent edge.
next_evidence_needed: Cross-sectional ranking via alpha_score is closed for new alpha on robust broad-universe evidence: the edge shrinks when the universe broadens (the opposite of a generalizable alpha) and the only tilt is single-regime (late_strong). Do not propose alpha_score reweighting as a live ranking/sizing change. Reviving a ranking surface needs genuinely populated non-momentum components on the broad universe AND a per-regime robustness requirement. The parallel default-off alpha_score paper adapters (exp-20260531-005/025/029, exp-20260601-001) likely lean on the same late_strong-regime top-quantile momentum tilt; forward replacement value across regimes is the real test.

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched and stronger: on the broad universe even RS falls below floor; composite ladder non-monotonic and 1/3 windows; expectation/PEAD still constant. Broadening shrank the edge.
